report.explanation: Current telemetry contradicts the operator hypothesis: checkout traces show all 200/ok across order, inventory, payment, and postgres; order metrics show 21.3 successful /v1/orders 200s and zero 502s on version 1.0.0. The deployment record only shows baseline 1.0.0 with no prior version, so it cannot establish deployment-caused errors. No bounded cause is supported; hand off.
